issues.jp_before: 子[こ]どもたち{は/が|wa-topic}紙[かみ]{で|de-material}飛行機[ひこうき]{を|o-object}折[お]りました。
issues.problem: English redundant: 'folded paper airplanes out of paper'.
issues.action: English changed to 'The children folded airplanes out of paper.'

issues.jp_before: あの古[ふる]い橋[はし]{は/が|wa-topic}石[いし]{で|de-material}できています。
issues.problem: Distractor から: 石からできている is acceptable (material composition with できる), not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor から with が.

issues.jp_before: 弟[おとうと]{は/が|wa-topic}ペットボトル{で|de-material}ロボット{を|o-object}作[つく]りました。
issues.problem: Distractor から: ペットボトルからロボットを作る is natural for a native speaker.
issues.action: Replaced distractor から with が.

issues.jp_before: この箱[はこ]{は/が|wa-topic}厚[あつ]い紙[かみ]{で|de-material}できています。
issues.problem: Distractor から: 紙からできている is acceptable with できる.
issues.action: Replaced distractor から with が.

issues.jp_before: あの大[おお]きな像[ぞう]{は/が|wa-topic}銅[どう]{で|de-material}造[つく]られました。
issues.problem: 銅 is copper, but the English says bronze.
issues.action: Changed 銅[どう] to 青銅[せいどう].

issues.jp_before: 学校[がっこう]{の|no-possessive}机[つくえ]{は/が|wa-topic}木[き]{で|de-material}作[つく]られています。
issues.problem: lv 5 is too low: the passive 作られています is N4 grammar.
issues.action: lv changed to 4.

issues.jp_before: 母[はは]{は/が|wa-topic}白[しろ]い毛糸[けいと]{で|de-material}手袋[てぶくろ]{を|o-object}編[あ]んでくれました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of line 1 (mother knits with yarn).
issues.action: Rewrote as 砂[すな]{で|de-material}大[おお]きなお城[しろ]{を|o-object}作[つく]ろう。 'Let's build a big castle out of sand.' with distractors を/が/と (に avoided because 砂に can mean 'on the sand').

issues.jp_before: 寒[さむ]さ{で|de-cause}手[て]{が|ga-subject}動[うご]きません。
issues.problem: Distractor に: 寒さに is a natural cause marker with physical reactions to cold, so it is not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with と.

issues.jp_before: 暑[あつ]さ{で|de-cause}みんな{が/は|ga-subject}疲[つか]れています。
issues.problem: Distractor に: 暑さに疲れる is natural.
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with と.

issues.jp_before: 隣[となり]{の|no-possessive}部屋[へや]{の|no-possessive}音[おと]{で|de-cause}目[め]{が|ga-subject}覚[さ]めました。
issues.problem: Distractor に: 物音に目が覚める is a standard native expression.
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with から.

issues.jp_before: 部長[ぶちょう]{は|wa-topic}仕事[しごと]{の|no-possessive}疲[つか]れ{で|de-cause}倒[たお]れました。
issues.problem: Clumsy English 'collapsed from exhaustion from work'.
issues.action: English changed to 'The department head collapsed, exhausted from work.'

issues.jp_before: 昨日[きのう]{は|wa-topic}雨[あめ]{で|de-cause}サッカー{が/は|ga-subject}できませんでした。
issues.problem: Wrong skill id: が with できる is ga-stative.
issues.action: Changed slot skill to ga-stative.

issues.jp_before: 大[おお]きな音[おと]{で|de-cause}赤[あか]ちゃん{が/は|ga-subject}泣[な]きました。
issues.problem: Distractor に: 大きな音に (reacting to a sound) is acceptable.
issues.action: Replaced distractor に with から.

issues.jp_before: 霧[きり]{で|de-cause}山[やま]{が/は|ga-subject}見[み]えません。
issues.problem: Wrong skill id: が with 見える is ga-sense.
issues.action: Changed slot skill to ga-sense.

issues.jp_before: 工事[こうじ]{で|de-cause}道[みち]{が/は|ga-subject}通[とお]れません。
issues.problem: Wrong skill id and missing alternative: potential 通れる takes が or を.
issues.action: Slot changed to {が/を/は|potential-ga}.

issues.jp_before: 叫[さけ]びすぎ{で|de-cause}声[こえ]{が|ga-subject}出[で]ません。
issues.problem: Unnatural English 'I can't get my voice out'.
issues.action: English changed to 'I've lost my voice from shouting too much.'

issues.jp_before: 彼女[かのじょ]{は|wa-topic}うれしさ{で|de-cause}泣[な]きました。
issues.problem: Distractor に: emotion + に (うれしさに泣く) is natural, and から is also acceptable, so swapping a distractor cannot fix the item.
issues.action: Rewrote as 彼女[かのじょ]{は|wa-topic}仕事[しごと]{の|no-possessive}ストレス{で|de-cause}体調[たいちょう]{を|o-object}崩[くず]しました。 'She got sick from the stress of her job.' f=2.

issues.jp_before: 兄[あに]{は|wa-topic}足[あし]{の|no-possessive}けが{で|de-cause}サッカー{を|o-object}やめました。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of line 9 (足のけがで).
issues.action: Rewrote as 兄[あに]{は|wa-topic}腰[こし]{の|no-possessive}痛[いた]み{で|de-cause}仕事[しごと]{を|o-object}休[やす]みました。 'My older brother took time off work because of back pain.'

issues.jp_before: 友達[ともだち]{は|wa-topic}お金[かね]{の|no-possessive}問題[もんだい]{で|de-cause}困[こま]っています。
issues.problem: Distractor に: 困る takes に for its cause (お金の問題に困る is natural; ni-reason).
issues.action: Rewrote with the verb 家を売りました: 'My friend sold their house because of money problems.'

issues.jp_before: 事故[じこ]{で|de-cause}道[みち]{が/は|ga-subject}込[こ]んでいます。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of line 3 (事故で, traffic).
issues.action: Rewrote as お祭[まつ]り{で|de-cause}道[みち]{が/は|ga-subject}込[こ]んでいます。 'The roads are crowded because of the festival.'

issues.jp_before: 暗[くら]さ{で|de-cause}足元[あしもと]{が|ga-subject}見[み]えませんでした。
issues.problem: Wrong skill id: が with 見える is ga-sense.
issues.action: Changed slot skill to ga-sense.

issues.jp_before: あまりの痛[いた]さ{で|de-cause}涙[なみだ]{が|ga-subject}出[で]ました。
issues.problem: Distractor に: あまりの〜に is the standard pattern, so に is arguably better than で here.
issues.action: Rewrote as 雷[かみなり]{で|de-cause}家[いえ]{の|no-possessive}電気[でんき]{が/は|ga-subject}消[き]えました。 'The lights in the house went out because of lightning.'
